# C68 H18 fast sanitizer

Same-lineage throughput copy of selected C68 H18 slot five. It retains the
unchanged C68 source with preemption disabled, H6 terminal extras, active
safety, and the frozen step-zero wheat/cow slot swap. Its localized exact
diagnostic bypasses the expensive parity-hash sanitizer only when every
request succeeds, with the original sanitizer retained as fallback.

The policy has no searched parameters and makes no economic change. This is the
final implementation: additional fixed-array and sanitizer shortcuts were
measured, but were neutral/slower or changed an action and were reverted. The
retained sanitizer is action-identical over all 4,096 shop sequences and both
seats and measured 31.48x faster than its original safety implementation.
